description: PCEPILFE = PCE price index excl. food and energy (core); PCEPI = PCE price index (headline); FRED/ALFRED series of BEA NIPA Table 2.8.7/2.4.4 chain-type price index, 2017=100
Index level 2017=100; mm/yy columns are percent change, computed as (L_t/L_t-1 - 1)*100 using levels at 3 decimals
ref_month 2024-01 .. 2026-09 (monthly, m/m horizon one month; yy = 12-month)
Earliest ALFRED realtime_start with a value for that month (ALFRED vintage date; treated as BEA release date; verify against BEA schedule)
m/m and y/y use ALL levels as they stood in that single first-release vintage (so prior month may already be revised)
Both levels as of the latest vintage (2026-10-29 vintage for Aug-Sep 2026; 2026-09-30 annual update for earlier months). Pulled 2026-11-11
First-print m/m rounded half-up to 0.1 from our 3-decimal-level calc; BEA's own published rounded figure uses unrounded indexes and can differ by 0.1 occasionally
